mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} (device_id, data_time, pressure, flow, ph, turbidity, residual_cl, temperature, level, is_clean, create_time) VALUES (#{rec.deviceId}, #{rec.dataTime}, #{rec.pressure}, #{rec.flow}, #{rec.ph}, #{rec.turbidity}, #{rec.residualCl}, #{rec.temperature}, #{rec.level}, COALESCE(#{rec.isClean}, 1), COALESCE(#{rec.createTime}, NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = #{tableName}
